result.summary: Overall layout is mostly clean; one minor visual inconsistency found regarding heart icon contrast on the ramen card.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icon on the 'Tokumaru Ramen' card is white/outline on a busy food image background, making it low-contrast and harder to see compared to the solid dark circle behind the heart icon on the pizza card below it.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent semi-transparent dark circle background behind the heart icon across all promotional cards for better visibility and consistency.
